corrections.corrected_statement: New Hampshire requires restraints for occupants younger than 18, subject to the child-safety-law exceptions, and recommends restraint use at every age.
corrections.note: Requirement with exceptions is stated on page 18, not page 17.

corrections.corrected_statement: Place the shoulder belt over the shoulder and chest with very little slack rather than routing it below the arm or behind the back.
corrections.note: Prohibition completes on page 18, not the cited page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Use a horn when communication with another road user requires it, because inappropriate horn use can startle or anger others.
corrections.note: The anger wording completes on page 22, not page 21.

corrections.corrected_statement: The law requires buses that carry passengers and trucks carrying flammable or hazardous material to stop before any railroad crossing even if there is no sign of a train coming.
corrections.note: Corrected vehicles to trucks to match the page wording.

corrections.corrected_statement: Defensive driving means watching for illegal acts and driving errors of other drivers and adjusting your driving to avoid a crash.
corrections.note: Narrowed the watch from all road users to other drivers.
